Name: Map-Teleport
Author: K1riko87
Description:
中文版
《地图传送》让玩家可以直接通过原版世界地图前往山谷中的各个地点，不需要额外制作传送道具，也不会添加独立的传送菜单。
地图选点传送
打开游戏原版地图后，用鼠标左键点击地图上的目的地即可传送。模组会把地图坐标转换为实际游戏位置，并在传送前验证目的地是否安全。
地图外框保持原版尺寸，不会占用额外的大型界面。
山谷、沙漠和姜岛
地图顶部提供三个区域页面：
[list]
[*]山谷[/*]
[*]沙漠[/*]
[*]姜岛[/*]
[/list]从山谷前往沙漠或姜岛时，会先抵达游戏原版传送图腾或方尖塔所使用的落点。到达当地后重新打开地图，即可继续选择该区域内的具体位置。
缩放与平移
[list]
[*]鼠标滚轮：以鼠标所在位置为中心缩放地图。[/*]
[*]按住鼠标中键拖动：平移地图。[/*]
[*]鼠标左键：选择目的地并传送。[/*]
[/list]玩家可以放大地图后更准确地选择道路、建筑或其他地点。
自动寻找安全落点
如果点击的位置是水面、障碍物、墙体或其他不可通行区域，模组不会强行把玩家放进去，而是寻找同一可达区域内距离目标最近的安全格子。
点击建筑时，会优先把玩家送到建筑入口外，而不是传送进墙体或建筑内部。
如果附近没有可靠的安全落点，传送会被取消。
保留游戏进度限制
默认情况下，地图传送不会绕过原版游戏的解锁条件，包括：
[list]
[*]尚未修好的沙漠巴士。[/*]
[*]尚未修好的采石场桥梁。[/*]
[*]尚未开放的铁路和山路。[/*]
[*]尚未砍开的秘密森林入口。[/*]
[*]尚未获得进入下水道的权限。[/*]
[*]尚未修好的威利的船。[/*]
[*]尚未开放的姜岛北部、西部、度假村和农舍。[/*]
[*]尚未完成条件的任务区域。[/*]
[/list]点击未解锁地区时，游戏会显示对应原因，而不是执行传送。
强制传送模式
按下 [b]Alt+F11[/b] 可以开启或关闭“强制传送”。
开启后，模组会忽略地区的进度门槛，例如在采石场桥梁修复前前往采石场。该设置会保存到
[code]config.json[/code]。
强制传送只会跳过进度限制，不会关闭以下保护：
[list]
[*]地图边界检查。[/*]
[*]碰撞与落点检查。[/*]
[*]安全格子验证。[/*]
[*]当前状态检查。[/*]
[*]未知地图保护。[/*]
[/list]因此，即使开启强制模式，也不会把玩家送进水面、墙体或地图外。
状态保护
在以下情况下，地图传送会被暂时拒绝：
[list]
[*]正在进行事件。[/*]
[*]正在游玩小游戏。[/*]
[*]正在使用工具。[/*]
[*]正在骑乘坐骑。[/*]
[*]玩家当前无法移动。[/*]
[*]游戏正在进行场景切换或淡出。[/*]
[/list]这样可以避免传送打断重要流程或导致异常状态。
地图兼容范围
当前版本优先支持 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6 原版世界地图[/b]。
无法唯一对应到一个原版地点的坐标、未知地图区域以及没有安全落点的位置都会被拒绝。其他 Mod 新增的世界地图区域需要单独的适配数据，默认不会被盲目识别或传送。
安装要求
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 或更高版本[/*]
[*]中文版和英文版只能选择一个安装，不能同时放入
[code]Mods[/code]文件夹。[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]English Version[/heading]
Map Teleport lets you travel directly through Stardew Valley’s vanilla world map. It does not require crafted teleport items and does not replace the map with a separate travel menu.
Click-to-travel map
Open the vanilla world map and left-click a destination to travel there. The mod converts the selected map position into an in-game location and verifies the destination before moving the player.
The map keeps its original frame size instead of opening an oversized custom interface.
Valley, Desert, and Ginger Island
Three regional tabs are available at the top of the map:
[list]
[*]Valley[/*]
[*]Desert[/*]
[*]Ginger Island[/*]
[/list]When travelling from the Valley to Calico Desert or Ginger Island, you first arrive at the standard warp-totem or obelisk landing tile. Once there, reopen the map to choose a more specific destination within that region.
Zooming and panning
[list]
[*]Mouse wheel: Zoom around the cursor.[/*]
[*]Hold the middle mouse button and drag: Pan the map.[/*]
[*]Left-click: Select a destination and travel.[/*]
[/list]Zooming in makes it easier to choose roads, buildings, and precise areas.
Safe landing resolution
If the selected point is water, a wall, an obstacle, or another blocked tile, the mod will not place the player there. Instead, it searches for the nearest safe tile within the same reachable area.
Clicking a building prioritizes the tile outside its entrance rather than placing the player inside a wall or inaccessible interior.
Travel is cancelled if no reliable landing tile can be found.
Progression-aware travel
By default, Map Teleport respects the game’s normal progression locks, including:
[list]
[*]The unrepaired desert bus.[/*]
[*]The unrepaired quarry bridge.[/*]
[*]Blocked railroad and mountain routes.[/*]
[*]The blocked entrance to the Secret Woods.[/*]
[*]Sewer access.[/*]
[*]Willy’s unrepaired boat.[/*]
[*]Locked sections of Ginger Island.[/*]
[*]Quest areas that have not yet been unlocked.[/*]
[/list]Selecting a locked destination displays the relevant reason instead of bypassing the requirement.
Locked-area override
Press [b]Alt+F11[/b] to toggle the locked-area override. The setting is saved in
[code]config.json[/code].
When enabled, progression requirements are ignored, allowing travel to places such as the quarry before its bridge is repaired.
The override only bypasses progression gates. It does not disable:
[list]
[*]Map-boundary checks.[/*]
[*]Collision checks.[/*]
[*]Safe-tile validation.[/*]
[*]Player-state checks.[/*]
[*]Unknown-map protection.[/*]
[/list]Even with the override enabled, the player will not be placed in water, walls, or outside the map.
Player-state protection
Map travel is temporarily unavailable while:
[list]
[*]An event is running.[/*]
[*]A minigame is active.[/*]
[*]The player is using a tool.[/*]
[*]The player is riding a mount.[/*]
[*]The player cannot move.[/*]
[*]The game is fading or changing scenes.[/*]
[/list]These checks prevent travel from interrupting important game states.
Compatibility scope
The current version primarily supports the [b]vanilla Stardew Valley 1.6 world map[/b].
Ambiguous points, unknown map regions, and destinations without a verified safe tile are rejected. World-map regions added by other mods require dedicated adapter data and are not blindly treated as valid destinations.
Requirements
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Install either the Chinese or English package, not both.[/*]
[/list]
